Resolved case CASE-20260611-seed01
Summary: Guest added a second room night through the website; the reservation showed the new checkout date but the confirmation still showed the old one.
Root cause: The confirmation job for the new reservation version failed with a template timeout and was not retried.
Fix applied: reservation___reissueConfirmation for the reservation. A new confirmation matching the current version was sent.
Outcome: Guest confirmed receipt the same day.
Sources: runbooks/booking-changes.md

Resolved case CASE-20260803-seed02
Summary: Silver member reported no points four days after a two-night stay.
Root cause: Late checkout kept the folio open until after the nightly accrual batch; the accrual was marked FAILED and never retried.
Fix applied: loyalty___creditPoints for the stay, using qualifying spend x 5 base points (no Silver bonus).
Outcome: Points credited; balance updated immediately.
Sources: runbooks/loyalty-points.md, policies/points-earning.md

Resolved case CASE-20260915-seed03
Summary: Guest asked about a charge described as RESORT INCIDENTALS a day after checkout.
Root cause: The folio had no incidentals and a zero balance, but the incidentals reconciliation job captured the check-in hold instead of releasing it.
Fix applied: payment___refundCharge for the incidentals capture, full amount.
Outcome: Refund issued to the original card; guest told to expect it within 5 to 10 business days.
Sources: runbooks/card-charges.md, policies/refunds.md

Resolved case CASE-20261002-seed04
Summary: Guest did not recognize a charge with descriptor RESORT STAY followed by a reservation number.
Root cause: No error. The charge was the folio settlement at checkout and matched the folio total.
Fix applied: none. The representative explained the descriptor.
Outcome: Guest satisfied; no change made.
Sources: runbooks/card-charges.md
